title: AI for HR and recruitment
description: Improve communications and learning materials while protecting people’s information and reviewing fairness.

sections.title: Improve communication with clear criteria
sections.body: Use AI to clarify a job description, onboarding checklist, or training outline from approved material. Check whether requirements are relevant to the role and language is accessible. Generated text can reproduce assumptions or bias, so review the substance as well as the tone.
bullets: Verify policies and benefits against authoritative internal sources.

sections.title: Treat candidate and employee data carefully
sections.body: Applications, performance information, and employee questions can contain sensitive personal details. Use only approved systems and the minimum necessary information. Understand applicable employment, privacy, and discrimination rules before considering an automated assessment process.
bullets: Check access, retention, and vendor arrangements.

sections.title: Keep consequential decisions accountable
sections.body: Do not assume a generated ranking is fair or valid because it is numerical. Any system affecting hiring, promotion, or employment needs appropriate legal, fairness, and operational review. Provide human oversight and a route to challenge or correct inaccurate information.
bullets: Document the criteria and evaluation method.
Test for errors and unequal effects before adoption.

example.title: A low-risk starting point
example.text: Ask an approved assistant to simplify a public job description while preserving essential requirements. A recruiter and hiring manager check relevance, accessibility, and policy compliance before publication.

exercise: Review a fictional job description. Highlight vague requirements and rewrite them into observable, role-relevant criteria.

faq.question: Can AI choose the best candidate?
faq.answer: A model’s output does not establish job suitability or fairness. Consequential selection requires valid criteria, appropriate oversight, and compliance with applicable rules.

faq.question: What is a good training use?
faq.answer: Drafting a general onboarding outline from approved policies is a useful starting task when a responsible person reviews it.
